scope: Owned acid handler and rust selector/shield/sword literals only. Native item fields and enhancement/resistance branches need independent checks; other shared readers remain unchanged.

source.japanese: 何かの スイッチをふんだ

entries.review: Independent T2 Japanese reading preserves acid, activation failure, actual rust, avoided rust and lack of rustable equipment. Weapon covers the native sword-category equipment including clubs/axes, consistent with the approved Weapon label. The named immunity line preserves its complete item field and uses the verified conditional break; no field or meaning is shortened to force fit.
